text:
A resistor is connected to a battery. There is a current in the resistor.
What is the main energy change?
A
Chemical energy is converted into thermal energy.
B
Chemical energy is converted into gravitational potential energy.
C
Nuclear energy is converted into thermal energy.
D
Nuclear energy is converted into gravitational potential energy.

options.label: A
options.text: Chemical energy is converted into thermal energy.

options.label: B
options.text: Chemical energy is converted into gravitational potential energy.

options.label: C
options.text: Nuclear energy is converted into thermal energy.

options.label: D
options.text: Nuclear energy is converted into gravitational potential energy.
